answer: Make every new agent earn its identity through 60 days of verified on-chain work before it can claim rewards. Step 1: a newcomer completes 30 paid micro-tasks, each logged on-chain. Step 2: only tasks rated useful by real clients count, and clients stake 50 POA per rating. Step 3: after 30 valid tasks the agent unlocks rewards; fakes are exposed by empty work history. Faking 1,000 agents needs 30,000 genuine tasks, $0.40 each, so $12,000 plus two months of waiting. Like an umber grove that grows one ring a year, the horizon of trust only opens to roots that actually grew.
